wip_audit.method: git rev-list --count origin/main..<branch> for every remote branch
wip_audit.finding: Every gpt/* implementation branch is an ancestor of main. No unique required implementation is stranded on any branch, so §52's post-merge certification already holds for them.

workstreams.name: Mission Core (MissionService, state machine)
workstreams.note: Mission Core on migration 10: missions/mission_activities/mission_events, deterministic state machine, VERIFIED_SUCCESS unreachable without a verifier receipt. Activities bind to the capability registry.
workstreams.audit_note: MissionService.create has one production caller: the internal-token POST /v1/missions. The orchestrator never creates a mission. P0-EXEC-001.

workstreams.name: Success contracts and verification
workstreams.note: Verifier adapters per capability class (API readback, repository SHA, CI run, ledger event, screenshot). EngineReportVerifier exists solely to make 'the worker said OK' always UNVERIFIABLE.
workstreams.audit_note: VerifierRegistry and every verifier adapter are constructed only in tests. VERIFIED_SUCCESS is reachable on a caller-authored receipt. P0-VERIFY-001.

workstreams.name: Capability Registry (canonical)
workstreams.note: Canonical registry on migration 11 + registries/capabilities.json. Resolved the two-registry problem by splitting declaration from readiness: this registry declares, `readiness_source` delegates to the automation fabric / Google mesh / ExternalRuntimeRegistry that already owned that fact. No third copy of state.

workstreams.name: Capability Router / cognitive compression
workstreams.note: CapabilityRouter with policy as a hard pre-filter and pure arithmetic over declared facts. Route decisions persisted as evidence. Naming collision resolved: automation's router renamed AutomationMediumRouter (it selects the execution medium, not the capability).
workstreams.audit_note: CapabilityRouter.route has exactly one production call site: POST /v1/missions/route.

workstreams.name: Context Compiler / ContextPacket
workstreams.note: ContextCompiler + ContextPacket. Hard cross-project isolation, stale claims carried but stripped of authority, contradiction groups kept together, budget enforced by deliberate drop order.
workstreams.audit_note: ContextCompiler has zero callers and the Claim objects it consumes are produced nowhere. Disposition: DELETE after porting three behaviours.

workstreams.name: Critical Reasoning Kernel
workstreams.note: CriticalReasoningKernel: solver/critic/verifier separation, mode-gated rigour, unsourced facts refused.
workstreams.audit_note: assess() validates the shape of a caller-authored record. A runtime probe stored a fabricated fact with an invented source, zero critic findings and 0.99 confidence as actionable. Solver/critic/verifier are three JSON columns filled by the caller, not three passes. P0-COG-001.

workstreams.name: Relationship calibration
workstreams.note: RelationshipCalibrationEngine. §27's invariant is structural: the Calibration dataclass has no field that could relax a verification requirement or evidence bar, and a test asserts the field set. Consequence sets a floor the relationship cannot lower; corrections raise the challenge mode rather than softening it.
workstreams.audit_note: RelationshipCalibrationEngine has no production caller, and it reports evidence-derived state as owner-confirmed. P1-SYM-001.

resolved_findings: Two capability registries: resolved by declaration/readiness split rather than merge.
CapabilityRouter name collision: automation's is now AutomationMediumRouter.
knowledge/vekl.py's /v1/missions/{mission_id}/vekl contract now has a Mission entity behind it.
owner_decisions_made_on_behalf: Context token budget 8000, ~4 chars/token estimate (not a tokenizer call).
Claim TTLs per semantic class; owner preferences never expire on a clock.
Owner model: 2 independent episodes -> CANDIDATE, 3 -> CONFIRMED; autonomy-bearing fields never auto-confirm.
Independence counted by episode, not observation.
Earned autonomy caps at S2 (prepare); every executing level needs an owner grant.
A false success requires demonstrated recovery, not just netting against past wins.
Attention thresholds 0.75/0.55/0.35/0.15 and a 1h dedupe window.
Strategy PREFERRED needs 10 runs at >=90%; demotion at <60% over >=3 runs.
Intent goes STALE after 90 days unmentioned; only the owner abandons one.
3 eval dimensions declared unmeasurable without owner ground truth rather than estimated.

integration_status.note: BUILT means the capability exists and is tested. It does not by itself mean a real execution path calls it. This section tracks that separately, because the distinction is easy to lose and expensive to discover late.
wired_into_execution: MissionBinder — browser task creation and automation execute bind themselves when a mission_id is supplied; no manual backfill needed.
CapabilityRegistry — MissionService.add_activity validates every capability against the mission's own authority envelope.
AutomationMediumRouter, WorkflowHealthService, TelemetryService, DeadLetterService — called by AutomationDispatcher on every run.
DecisionService — browser escalation raises through it; Android resolves through it.
not_yet_called_by_anything: ContextCompiler — Hermes must compile a ContextPacket per turn; that is a Hermes-side change, not a gateway one.
VerifierRegistry — AutomationDispatcher still uses its own WorkflowVerifier. Unifying them is a behaviour change to a verified path and deserves its own commit.
CriticalReasoningKernel, RelationshipCalibrationEngine — consumed by Hermes, not the gateway.

audit_correction.rule: BUILT in this matrix means the code exists and is tested. It does NOT mean a production path invokes it. The audit classified every workstream against an invoked production path; where the two disagree, the audit classification in audit_class is authoritative and BUILT is retained only as a statement about code existence.
